events.title: Samsung Galaxy Note 10 released
events.summary: Samsung released the Samsung Galaxy Note 10 — center punch-hole and removed headphone jack from the Note line.
events.about: The Galaxy Note targeted stylus power users on Android. Center punch-hole and removed headphone jack from the note line. Note apps and split-screen Android development often targeted this hardware class.

narrative.whyChosen: The Samsung Galaxy Note 10 advanced Samsung's stylus phablet line.
narrative.whyImportant: Galaxy Note hardware defined large-screen Android productivity for years.
narrative.problemSolved: Android lacked a premium large-screen stylus flagship for note-taking workflows.
